hospital_source.treatment_success_basis: temporary category-level coefficients copied from scripts/build_folium_municipal_simulator.py (0.86 for categories containing '센터', 0.78 for 지역응급의료기관, 0.25 when no bed is open, 75-minute bed occupancy, 5-minute transfer delay); not observed hospital outcomes

demand_source.basis: temporary estimate: official 2023 Gyeonggi headquarters dispatch total (data/raw/nfa_headquarters_ambulance_activity_20260910/nfa_headquarters_ambulance_activity_20231231.csv, 본부구분=경기, 년도=2023) divided by 365.25 and allocated by 2026-08 resident-population share; not observed municipal 119 calls
demand_source.provincial_population_reference: MOIS resident population 2026-08 (sum of the 31 municipalities in municipality_summary.csv)
demand_source.allocation_within_municipality: resident population share of each administrative dong in demand_population.csv; flat hourly rate
demand_source.coordinate_caveat: administrative-office representative points; not incident coordinates

candidate_source.interpretation: existing public-health facilities; requires planning review before any site is presented as feasible
candidate_source.model_assumption: temporary planning assumption: every new-build candidate is modelled as a 지역응급의료기관 with 20 emergency-room beds, 75-minute bed occupancy and unit cost; not a design or budget figure
